text: **dsh-ops** 为 DSH Web 会话提供工作区工具：搜索和读写文件、读取表格与文档、调用 Bash、执行 PTC 批处理，并按需发现工具。单行配置可按预设控制会话中显示的能力，适合在 DSH 内处理项目文件的开发者。原生文件与 PTC 功能需要 Rust worker；不需要 API key 或账号。

**dsh-ops** adds workspace tools to DSH Web: file search and edits, table/document reading, Bash, typed PTC batches, and on-demand tool discovery. Presets control what appears in a session. Native tools require the Rust worker; no API key or account is needed.
想直接在 DSH 会话里搜索并修改项目文件。
有没有办法按文件名模式列目录，再用正则找代码内容？
我想在模型步骤里按需加载文件工具，不要每次都展示全部能力。
让 DSH 能读取 CSV、TSV、DOCX 和 PDF 里的文本内容。
在对话中运行 Bash 命令，并查看标准输出和退出状态。
我需要把多项文件复制或移动操作作为一个 PTC 批次处理。
How can I search project files with glob patterns and regular expressions inside DSH?
I want to inspect and revise workspace files from a DSH session with revision checks.
Can DSH read rows from CSV or TSV and extract text from DOCX or supported PDFs?
I need to select additional file capabilities only when a task calls for them.
dsh-ops 的功能「工作区文件操作」：在会话工作目录内读取、检查、比较、复制、移动、删除或更新文件；工具目录定义了各操作的参数和输出。
dsh-ops 的功能「文件检索」：ops_glob 按 glob 模式列出路径，ops_grep 用 Rust regex 检索文本，并支持筛选、分页和结果摘要。
dsh-ops 的功能「表格与文档读取」：读取分页 CSV/TSV 行、DOCX 正文段落，以及受支持 PDF 的文本层内容。
dsh-ops 的功能「Bash 命令」：调用会话配置的 Bash 执行脚本或命令，并返回 stdout、stderr、退出码、超时和取消状态。
dsh-ops 的功能「PTC 批处理」：在 PTC 会话中计划或运行多项文件复制、移动、删除操作，并通过结果引用分页读取批次结果。
dsh-ops 的功能「按需发现工具」：在 Native 模式下用自然语言或精确名称搜索能力；新选中的工具从下一模型步骤起可用。
dsh-ops 的功能「运行环境命令行管理」：通过 dsh-ops CLI 安装或卸载配置、查看状态、报告工具环境，并提供 Bash 与面板辅助命令。
dsh-ops 使用前须知：若当前环境未解析到 Rust worker，Native 文件工具不会发布；可由配置提供明确的 worker 路径。

dsh-ops README · dsh-ops：以提高token效率为目的，提供新增的ops系列工具并隐藏部分官方工具为方案的插件，低改动面，低侵入性，与其他插件广泛兼容。

dsh-ops README · dsh-ops：- Bash 与宿主 Shell 隐藏独立配置；Windows 可用 ops_bash 替代 pwsh，也可保留官方 Shell。
- Native/PTC 消费者预设发布共享的有界工具面；Bash 由单行开关控制，关闭替换时原版工具保持可用。
- 启用 DSH 预留的 `tools_addition` 动态工具加载，并提供渐进式纰漏的工具，作为高级功能（如pdf、word读取、超多文件批量修改）的加载平台，大大减少常见特定场景的token消耗量，且不会导致系统提示词膨胀
- 为 Native 模式提供返回紧凑、带行号和更好错误回馈的工具以遏制报错循环，减少调用轮次
- 为 PTC 模式提供一些返回结构化 JSON 值的工具以降低 ai 在 ptc 模式下编写 TypeScript 代码的token总量和心智负担
- PTC SDK 目录包含 18 个 API：15 个文件/文档工具，加批处理、结果引用和加载器。

dsh-ops README · 安装、更新、卸载：> 本分支候选的 Windows 默认载荷为完整 Niubash 1.5.0，随 `dsh-ops` 主包管理，不再默认下载 Git Bash 可选包。所有 npm、市场和 CLI 更新入口的二进制位置与清理边界见[升级与卸载](docs/升级与卸载.md#二进制位置与更新清理)。`@latest` 仍指已发布版本，不代表此 PR 已发布。

dsh-ops README · 官方插件市场：在目标 DSH 应用的插件市场中输入 npm 包名 **`dsh-ops`**，选择自定义地址，输入 `https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/repository/npm/`，安装后选择启用。目前不推荐用npmmirror安装，有bug。

当然，如果你确定可以连接 npm 官方源那就选择官方源，如果你不确定那就按教程操作。

dsh-ops README · 安装方法：```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile web
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile tui
```

必须显式选择目标 profile；`tui` 映射到 **dsh-TUI 产品的 `dsh-tui` profile**，不是旧的 `tui` 目录。请先初始化目标应用。该入口委托官方 DSH CLI 安装，不另写一套 profile 锁与回滚逻辑。

桌面端必须使用桌面应用自带的 CLI；默认探测 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`。安装在其它位置时加 `--dsh-cli "<安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"`。Web/TUI 需要可用的 DSH CLI，可同样显式指定。

dsh-ops README · 安装方法：安装或卸载时可加 `--dry-run` 预演。它按指定路径或 `PATH`（Windows 同时使用 `PATHEXT`）解析 CLI，检查文件、POSIX 执行权限及通过 Node 启动的入口文件，并在预演时同样拒绝不安全的 Windows 命令脚本路径；检查失败返回非零。预演只打印计划，不启动 CLI、不修改 profile。成功表示这些静态检查已通过，不保证所选程序的身份、版本、profile 兼容性或后续安装结果。

也可以直接使用官方命令：

```console
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ops
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-ops
"<桌面安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ops
```

普通 DSH CLI 不能管理保留的 `desktop` profile；不要把它与桌面自带入口混淆。

dsh-ops README · 安装方法：请安装 registry 发行包，或已完整构建并打包的源码 tarball。直接 `git+https` 安装与未构建的
源码检出缺少完整运行时；见[不支持通过 Git 通道安装](docs/升级与卸载.md#不支持通过-git-通道安装)。

dsh-ops README · 更新方法：宿主支持从 DSH **0.2.2-rc.1** 起；0.5 系列不再支持 0.2.0/0.2.1 或更早的 0.2.2 预览版。保留 DSH adapter 结构，按 0.2.2 原生工具准入和执行器接口接入。

[宿主兼容范围与展示元数据](docs/使用指南.md#宿主兼容范围与展示元数据)。

重新运行相同的 `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile ...`，或用官方 CLI `add dsh-ops@latest`。按应用提示重载；替换已加载代码时重启应用。

dsh-ops README · 卸载与查看状态：```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest status --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --profile desktop
```

把 `desktop` 换成 `web` 或 `tui` 即可。也可在市场卸载，或执行官方 `dsh plugin --profile ... remove dsh-ops`。随包二进制由 profile 的包管理器管理；显式 provision 的副本不会随 npm 卸载，先查看 `dsh-ops bash-runtime status`，再用 `dsh-ops bash-runtime remove --dry-run` 预览、`remove --yes` 确认。不要误删系统 shell、其它 profile 或共享缓存。详见[二进制位置与更新清理](docs/升级与卸载.md#二进制位置与更新清理)。

dsh-ops README · 卸载与查看状态：旧版显式 provision 的 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-ops/` 文件（provision 的 shell，以及早期版本可 provision 的 FastCtx 运行时）需单独清理：`npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --yes`。已移除的后台组件留下的 `~/.fastctx/` 状态默认不删；需要时显式加 `--purge-fastctx`。

组件 bundle 只插入一个 `dsh-ops` 行：其中按预设配置常驻、动态加载、Bash、文件替换与宿主 PowerShell 隐藏，并可通过 `presets` 显式接入自定义消费者。内置与外部预设共用装配流程。旧 `mode-*`、`discovery`、`compat`、`panel`、`tui` 及更早的 `shell`、`file`、`ptc`、`hide-official` 行覆盖须迁入单行；兼容开关已移除，改用各项隐藏开关。见[配置参考](docs/配置参考.md)。
dsh-ops README · 卸载与查看状态：原 `dsh-ops/background` 组件（FastCtx 后台任务）已移除。仍保留该行的 profile 照常加载：该行不发布任何工具，只记录一条警告，可直接删除。

dsh-ops README · 可选 OPS 只读侧栏：在 dsh-TUI 中启用 `dsh-ops/tui` 行并重启，即可添加 OPS 侧栏；不抢焦点，不执行额外工具调用。没有 `tuiPanels` 的宿主仅让该可选行等待，不影响其它组件。见 [侧栏说明](docs/tui-panel.zh.md)。 聚焦后可用 `f` 筛选、`n`/`p` 本地翻页、`a` 确认跨会话提醒；只浏览有界保留元数据，不拉取结果分页。

dsh-ops README · dsh-ops：OPS adds bounded file and document tools to DSH. Native mode returns compact, line-numbered text;
PTC code receives typed Outcome values from the same one-shot Rust worker. Host integration is
strict TypeScript, compiled to the existing JavaScript package paths.

Supported: Windows x64, Linux x64, and macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon or Intel
(`darwin-arm64`, `darwin-x64`). See [macOS](docs/macos.md).

> checkout to evaluate the candidate. See the [changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-ops README · dsh-ops：- The single row enables the four built-in preset consumers: Standard and Cordis publish resident
  Native file tools, PTC publishes typed APIs, and Minimal has no resident file baseline. Native
  discovery and typed SDK loading are independently configured. Advanced selections activate in
  the owning agent's next provider request, never by executing a discovery action.
- The PTC SDK catalogue has 18 APIs: 15 file/document tools, batch, result references and its loader.
  Only the configured resident or selected APIs are exposed. Native and PTC use separate outputs.

  OCR, general PDF rendering, web search and HTML crawling are not implemented. Read the
  [document-format limits](docs/native-kernel.md) before choosing a reader.
- One native-switch configuration page controls built-in and explicitly listed custom consumers.
  Global switches gate per-preset choices without losing saved intent. Residency, dynamic loading,
  Bash, file replacement and Windows host-PowerShell hiding are independently controlled; panel

dsh-ops README · dsh-ops：OPS publishes its own scoped tools and optional routing guidance; it does not rewrite the shared
tool registry. Permissions and cancellation are checked per call. Windows restricted Bash retains
its documented partial enforcement and runtime-compatibility limits.

Historical token-saving claims are not evidence that this candidate meets its release gates.
The name “ops” means general operations, not an operations/SRE product.

dsh-ops README · Official plugin marketplace：In the target DSH application's plugin marketplace, enter the npm package name **`dsh-ops`**, choose a custom registry and enter `https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/repository/npm/`, install, then enable it. Installing through npmmirror is currently not recommended — it has bugs.

Of course, if you are sure you can reach the official npm registry, pick the official registry; if you are not sure, follow the steps above.

dsh-ops README · Installation：```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile web
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile tui
```

An explicit target profile is required. `tui` maps to the **dsh-TUI product's `dsh-tui` profile**, not the old `tui` directory. Initialize the target application first. This entry point delegates installation to the official DSH CLI rather than implementing a separate profile lock and rollback logic.

dsh-ops README · Installation：Desktop must use the CLI bundled with the desktop application; the default auto-detected path is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`. For another installation location, add `--dsh-cli "<installation>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"`. Web/TUI require an available DSH CLI, which can also be specified explicitly.

dsh-ops README · Installation：Add `--dry-run` to an install or uninstall command to preview it. The preview resolves the CLI from its path or `PATH` (`PATHEXT` on Windows), checks the file, POSIX execute permission and any Node CLI entry point, and applies the same Windows command-script path checks as execution. A failed check returns a nonzero exit code. The preview prints the plan without starting the CLI or changing the profile. Success covers these static checks; it does not establish the program's identity, version, profile compatibility or eventual installation result.

dsh-ops README · Installation：You can also use the official commands directly:

```console
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ops
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-ops
"<desktop installation>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ops
```

A regular DSH CLI cannot manage the reserved `desktop` profile; do not confuse it with the desktop app's own entry point.

dsh-ops README · Installation：Install the published registry package or a fully built and packed source tarball.
Direct `git+https` installation and unbuilt source checkouts lack the complete runtime; see
[installing from Git is not a supported channel](docs/upgrading.md#installing-from-git-is-not-a-supported-channel).

dsh-ops README · Update：The 0.5 series supports DSH **from 0.2.2-rc.1**, not 0.2.0/0.2.1 or earlier 0.2.2 previews. The DSH adapter remains; integration uses the native 0.2.2 tool-admission and executor APIs. See

dsh-ops README · Update：Re-run the same `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest install --profile ...`, or use the official CLI `add dsh-ops@latest`. Reload when the app asks; restart the app when replacing code that is already loaded.

dsh-ops README · Uninstall and status：```console
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest status --profile desktop
npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --profile desktop
```

dsh-ops README · Uninstall and status：Replace `desktop` with `web` or `tui` as needed. You can also uninstall from the marketplace, or run the official `dsh plugin --profile ... remove dsh-ops`. Profile uninstall removes plugin dependency references, including the optional Windows Bash payload. Remove separately provisioned Bash with `dsh-ops bash-runtime remove --yes`; this does not delete the system shell, copies in other profiles, or the package manager's shared cache.

dsh-ops README · Uninstall and status：Old files explicitly provisioned by earlier versions under `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-ops/` (provisioned shells, and the FastCtx runtime earlier versions could provision) need separate cleanup: `npx --yes dsh-ops@latest uninstall --yes`. The `~/.fastctx/` state left by the removed background component is not deleted by default; add `--purge-fastctx` when needed.

dsh-ops README · Uninstall and status：The former `dsh-ops/background` component (FastCtx background jobs) has been removed. A profile that still has its row keeps loading: the row publishes nothing and logs one warning, and can be deleted.

dsh-ops README · Optional read-only OPS sidebar：Enable `tui.enabled` on the `dsh-ops` row in dsh-TUI and restart to add the OPS sidebar without stealing focus or executing tools. Without `tuiPanels`, only that optional row stays pending. See [Sidebar guide](docs/tui-panel.md). While focused, use `f` to filter, `n`/`p` for local pages and `a` to acknowledge all-session alerts; only bounded retained metadata is browsed, never fetched result pages.

dsh-ops README · Windows Bash diagnostics：Windows Bash diagnostics: `dsh-ops ladder` reports image and ancestor integrity
labels separately from static MSYS hash compatibility. A Low-labelled executable
can start a Low child even in full access, preventing writes to existing
Medium/unlabeled files. Unreadable labels remain unknown. See
[integrity inspection](docs/troubleshooting.md#windows-bash-integrity-labels).
